howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1: Enter your CCP number in the input field on this website
howItWorks.step2: Our algorithm calculates the CCP Key using a special formula
howItWorks.step3: The RIP Key is generated based on the CCP number
howItWorks.step4: Finally, we construct the full RIB using the calculated keys
howItWorks.step5: Receive your results instantly on the page!
